title: Kate Project Configuration
description: Schema for Kate editor project configuration files (.kateproject)

name.description: The human-readable display name of the project in Kate's sidebar.

directory.description: The base directory root of the project. Defaults to the folder containing the .kateproject file.

exclude_patterns.description: An array of regular expression strings matching files or directories to exclude from the project.

files.description: List of automatic or manual file discovery methods used to populate the project tree.

git.description: Set to 1 to automatically load files indexed by Git version control.

hg.description: Set to 1 to automatically load files indexed by Mercurial version control.

svn.description: Set to 1 to automatically load files indexed by Subversion version control.

directory.description: Explicit subdirectory path relative to the project root to load manually.

recursive.description: Whether to scan the specified directory recursively for files.

filters.description: Glob file extensions/patterns to match against when loading the specified directory manually.

build.description: Configuration targets for Kate's Build Plugin.

directory.description: The directory where execution commands will run.

build.description: The command string utilized for standard project compilation.

quick.description: The command string utilized for partial or rapid compilation.

clean.description: The command string utilized to delete build artifacts.

formatting.description: Configuration overrides for Kate's external formatting engine plugin.

formatOnSave.description: Enables or disables auto-formatting the file active view anytime a save event triggers.

^formatterFor[a-zA-Z0-9+_#-]+$.description: Specifies the target binary layout mapping for a specific programming language extension type (e.g., formatterForJson: 'jq').

lspclient.description: Project-specific Language Server Protocol (LSP) client overrides.

command.description: Command and arguments to start the LSP server. Supports Kate variable expansion.

commandDebug.description: Command and arguments used to run the server in a debugging mode.

root.description: The root path of the language server workspace. Relative to projectBase if not absolute.

rootIndicationFileNames.description: Files that specify a project root folder (e.g., ['package.json', 'Cargo.toml']).

url.description: Reference URL pointing to the language server plugin repository.

highlightingModeRegex.description: Regex matching Kate's syntax highlighting names to map files to this server.

use.description: Allows a language variant to inherit from an existing base definition (e.g., 'deno-ts' using 'deno-js').

initializationOptions.description: Arbitrary options passed straight to the LSP initialization object.

settings.description: Dynamic configuration settings pushed down to the active LSP instance.
